# [IMPL] V8.6 M08: Reconcile exactly-once engine cashflow independently

## Objective
Reconcile exactly-once engine cashflow independently. This work transfers or verifies the ownership required by the full V8.6 monograph; dependency installation alone is not completion.

## Owning authority
- Tracking identity: [#372](https://github.com/ddawnlll/v8/issues/372).
- V8.6 full text: docs/contracts/V8_6_PRODUCTION_RECALIBRATION_FULL_TEXT.html — §11.2; §16.1; G3/G5; §20.5.
- docs/WORK_ITEM_POLICY.md §§3–4; Constitution Rules 12 and 44; root AGENTS.md.
- The preserved monograph is PROVISIONAL, not an override of existing higher authority.

## Change class
CONTRACT_IMPLEMENTATION

## Current state
No reconciliation receipt exists for the new engine yet.

## Required end state
All R requirements below are satisfied by actual consumer behavior and revision-bound evidence. Replacements include removal of superseded active implementation after acceptance.

## Expected file / module surface
v8-core/src/cashflow.rs; execution reconciliation (proposed); portfolio snapshots. Proposed paths are planned outputs, not existing artifacts.

## Verification gates
Real physical ledgers and reconciliation report; mutation tests missing/duplicated events; exact declared numeric policy, no invented tolerance.
Required checks follow the actual touched surfaces and D-099; do not repeat already-green full suites for metadata-only edits.

## Required evidence artifacts
Per-R implementation commit, verification command/CI run and physical receipt path plus hash where applicable. PENDING until generated; no invented artifact links.

## Non-goals / forbidden scope
No autonomous merge, direct main push, frozen Python edits, synthetic production/evaluation inputs, fabricated economics, new Expert family, new platform or unrelated refactor. All implementation and tests stay in Rust under v8-core/.

## 11. Normative Traceability
| Requirement | Observable result | Exact authority | Verification / receipt |
|---|---|---|---|
| R1 | Independently reconcile opening equity plus external flows, realized/unrealized PnL, fees and funding to closing equity under documented units. | §20.5 | M08-R1: PENDING; use discriminating gates above |
| R2 | Detect duplicate/missing cashflows, funding double settlement, partial-fill replay, terminal settlement and account snapshot mismatch. | §20.2; §20.5 | M08-R2: PENDING; use discriminating gates above |
| R3 | Produce two frozen real runs with candidate/admission/intent/fill/cashflow/position/equity comparison; exclude only declared non-economic metadata. | §18.8; G5 | M08-R3: PENDING; use discriminating gates above |

## 12. Existing Types / Interfaces to Reuse
EconomicCashflow, CashflowLedger, Canon, M04 events/snapshots. New interfaces require registered decision/layout entries before implementation; do not invent parallel domain types.

## 13. Mathematical / Semantic Invariants
NO_ECONOMIC_CLAIM without valid authority; no future/unavailable input influences past decisions; identity and unit contracts are explicit; a library adapter must not recreate the delegated subsystem. Requirement-specific invariants are stated in R rows above.

## 14. Canonical Failure Semantics
Missing authority: BLOCKED / OPEN_PIN. Missing required evidence: PENDING, never PASS. Economic uncertainty: NO_ECONOMIC_CLAIM. Failed verification: FAIL. Use existing runtime error types when implementing, not new ad-hoc status strings.

## 15. Dependency Map
M05 + M06 + M07 -> M08.
Dependency identifiers refer to docs/migration/v86/PLAN.md; GitHub dependencies are linked in the Dependencies field. Prerequisite implementation acceptance is required before dependent completion; writing the dependent issue is allowed now.

## 16. Ambiguity / OPEN_PIN Triggers
Unexplained difference -> NO_ECONOMIC_CLAIM and blocked promotion; cannot normalize away financial fields.
Unknown owning semantics are not implementation discretion.

## Owner
@ddawnlll — accountable maintainer; execution by the authorized Codex migration task. GitHub assignee must match.

## Lifecycle
state:triage — requirements are written; readiness requires authority/dependency review. Not DONE merely because this body exists.

## Base SHA
e7d80f22888ff1e94f1be882c878f6af801d5375

## Completed R IDs
NONE — this issue set does not fabricate implementation completion.

## Remaining R IDs
R1, R2, R3

## Dependencies
M05 [#366](https://github.com/ddawnlll/v8/issues/366), M06 [#368](https://github.com/ddawnlll/v8/issues/368), M07 [#369](https://github.com/ddawnlll/v8/issues/369)

## Evidence
PENDING implementation receipts. Initial state: docs/migration/v86/evidence/pr-snapshot.json and issue-snapshot.json; source full-text SHA256 c766a472eb9095f87864c4dfeaf898877a06fd47eccdd44e8697c613a6eb01b1.

## Migration responsibility
- Current ownership: existing file/module surface above; verify actual consumers before editing.
- Delegated/retained boundary: defined by the R requirements; unsupported upstream APIs are OPEN_PIN.
- Consumer switch: acceptance must exercise active call sites, not an isolated dependency demo.
- Retirement: M17 after relevant R gates; history and useful witnesses preserved.
- Rollback: return to recorded pre-change revision without rewriting historical receipts; no automatic rollback/merge of shared branches.

## V8 guards
- [x] Requirements identify authority, scope, reuse, invariants, failures and dependencies.
- [x] No frozen Python or uncertified economic claim is authorized.
- [ ] Implementation and all requirement receipts complete.
